items.situation: expressing concern about a friend's situation
items.speaker: Where has Sophie been all week?

options.A: Beats me — I haven't seen her.
options.B: Her apartment's just past the library.
options.C: The whole week just flew by.
options.D: Yes, the test was really hard.

items.explanation: 说话人担心整周没见到 Sophie。A 用习语 “Beats me”（我也不知道）自然回应“我也没见到她”，最贴切。B 只答她住哪，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱（Where→地点）；C 借用 week 但只感叹时间过得快，属离题；D 用 Yes 回答特殊疑问句，答非所问且内容无关。

items.speaker: How do I move my dentist appointment?

options.A: The dentist's office looks brand new.
options.B: Don't worry, I'll call the office.
options.C: How about pizza for dinner tonight?
options.D: Yes, you should floss every day.

items.explanation: 说话人问怎么改牙医预约。B 没有逐字解释步骤，而是直接帮忙解决——“我来打电话”，属情境转移，最自然。A 借 dentist 描述诊所外观，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；C 完全跳到晚餐，属离题；D 用 Yes 回应特殊疑问句并谈护牙，答非所问。

items.situation: student asking about exam format or study materials
items.speaker: I'm not sure what's on the final exam.

options.A: The exam room is on the third floor.
options.B: I already turned in my lab report.
options.C: Well, the professor posted a study guide.
options.D: The vending machines are out of coffee.

items.explanation: 说话人不确定期末考什么内容。C 以 “Well” 开头，间接指向解决办法——教授发了复习提纲，最贴切。A 借 exam 谈考场位置，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；B 提交实验报告与考什么无关，属离题；D 谈自动贩卖机也完全离题。

items.situation: responding to an invitation or suggestion
items.speaker: When does the picnic start on Saturday?

options.A: The park has plenty of parking.
options.B: I love picnics in the summer.
options.C: Yes, please bring a dish to share.
options.D: Actually, it kicks off around noon.

items.explanation: 说话人问周六野餐几点开始。D 以 “Actually” 开头，间接给出时间“中午左右”，最贴切。A 借 picnic 联想到公园停车，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；B 只是抒发对野餐的喜爱，属离题；C 用 Yes 回答特殊疑问句，答非所问。

items.situation: asking a neighbor about noise or shared space
items.speaker: Can you turn the music down tonight?

options.A: Sure, I'll switch to my headphones.
options.B: The music store downtown just reopened.
options.C: No, I already ate before I came.
options.D: Yes, the speakers were pretty expensive.

items.explanation: 邻居请对方把音乐关小些。A 没有停留在字面，而是直接从根源解决——“我改用耳机”，属情境转移，最自然。B 借 music 谈唱片店，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；C 谈吃饭完全离题；D 用 Yes 却去描述音箱价格，答非所问。

items.situation: student asking a librarian about a book or resource
items.speaker: I can't find the book for my class.

options.A: The library closes at nine tonight.
options.B: Well, let me check the other branch.
options.C: I read a great novel last weekend.
options.D: Yes, reading really helps with writing.

items.explanation: 说话人找不到上课要用的书。B 以 “Well” 开头，间接提出解决办法——去别的分馆查一下，最贴切。A 借 library 谈闭馆时间，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；C 谈自己读的小说，属离题；D 对陈述句用 Yes 并泛谈阅读好处，答非所问。

items.situation: classmate asking to borrow lecture notes
items.speaker: What did I miss in today's lecture?

options.A: The lecture hall was freezing today.
options.B: I missed the bus this morning too.
options.C: Do you want to copy my notes?
options.D: Yes, attendance is worth ten percent.

items.explanation: 同学问今天讲课错过了什么。C 用一个反问推进对话——“要不要抄我的笔记？”，直接帮上忙，最贴切。A 借 lecture 谈教室冷，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；B 借 miss 谈错过公交，属离题；D 用 Yes 回答特殊疑问句，答非所问。

items.situation: arranging a ride or carpool with a friend
items.speaker: Why don't we drive together on Monday?

options.A: The highway was packed this morning.
options.C: Yes, my car is bright red.
options.D: Sure, what time works for you?

items.explanation: 朋友提议周一拼车。D 以反问推进——“行啊，你几点方便？”，顺势敲定安排，最自然。A 借 drive 谈早上堵车，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；B 只感叹周一累人，属离题；C 用 Yes 却去描述车的颜色，答非所问。

items.situation: student asking about printing or scanning at the computer lab
items.speaker: Can I scan these pages here?

options.A: Go right ahead, it's all yours.
options.C: No, I haven't eaten lunch yet.
options.D: The library's on the second floor.

items.explanation: 说话人问能不能在这里扫描。A 用习语 “Go right ahead”（尽管用）自然应允，最贴切。B 借 scanner 谈机器是新型号，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；C 谈午饭完全离题；D 谈图书馆位置也离题。

items.situation: friend sharing news or a personal update
items.speaker: Did you hear I got the internship?

options.A: The office building is quite tall.
options.C: I didn't hear the alarm today.
options.D: No, the printer is out of ink.

items.explanation: 朋友分享拿到实习的好消息。B 直接回应并道贺，最自然贴切。A 借 internship 联想到办公楼，答非所问，属语义联想陷阱；C 借 hear 谈没听见闹钟，属离题；D 用 No 却去谈打印机没墨，答非所问。
